marta_partnerships: Quick sync  vendor asked for an embargo-aware ETA for H200 / B200 / MI300 / Gaudi before we lock marketplace copy. Need lab + SI windows. @devon_infra @yara_si

devon_infra: Short status: B200 `power-curve-v5` looks stable so far; I'll run a 24h endurance. H200 BIOS v3 landed in partner CI but vendor notes a perf delta on 8k seqs. Gaudi needs kernel 6.2 backport (we're still on 5.15 in fleet).

yara_si: SI capacity: Tue/Thu mornings available. We require artifacts 48h before slot (BIOS, driver, kernel packages). If H200 BIOS keeps the perf regression we may need vendor rollback  that blocks GA for H200.

lucas_vendor: Uploading H200 BIOS v3 and B200 fanconf v5 now to s3://partners/redwood/1766667777/ . H200 BIOS note: fixes thermal bias but may change freq floor on long sequences. No press embargo beyond standard 48h.

marta_partnerships: Please paste sha256 + simple install steps here and confirm any embargo windows or press constraints.

lucas_vendor: SHA256: b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c. Install steps in README at s3://partners/redwood/1766667777/README.md. No extra embargo.

devon_infra: Scheduling endurance run Mon 23:00 UTC -> Tue 23:00 UTC. Will push image tag `b200-powerv5-1766667777` and post `perf_summary.csv` after.

deploy-bot: image b200-powerv5-1766667777 pushed to staging at 2024-08-15T23:05:00Z; smoke tests queued.

yara_si: If endurance passes, SI can run a full cert Thu 07:00 UTC. If H200 perf still regresses, propose Plan B: GA with H100 + B200 (certified), mark H200 / MI300 / Gaudi as "validating" in marketplace, and schedule a follow-on joint announcement for the patch window.

press_ops: Agreed. Keep marketplace copy conservative. I'll draft conditional blurb and hold until SI green + vendor 48h is observed.

marta_partnerships: Action recap (canonical): 1) lucas_vendor -> upload README + artifacts + sha (done), 2) devon_infra -> post endurance perf CSV and any perf diffs, 3) yara_si -> confirm SI Thu slot if endurance green, 4) press_ops -> hold conditional copy. Paste only S3 URIs and hashes in this thread. :lock: :spiral_calendar:
